shots.visual: Live-action, cinematic. A medium-wide shot frames a Japanese man standing beside a mountain lake at sunrise. Mist drifts across the water.
a close-up of his face as he turns toward the camera.

dialogue.text: AIと自然が、やっと同じ場所で動き始めた。
